info.name: LMS Backend API - Final
info.description:
Complete LMS API Collection updated for PostgreSQL + Prisma.

**SETUP ORDER:**

1. Register Admin → Login Admin
    
2. Seed Categories (auto-saves categoryId)
    
3. Register Instructor → Login Instructor
    
4. Register Student → Login Student
    
5. Create Course → Add Lessons → Publish
    
6. Enroll Student → Track Progress
    
7. Search & Discovery
    

**Key Changes from MongoDB version:**

- IDs are now UUIDs (strings) not ObjectIds
    
- Role field works correctly for all roles
    
- All tokens auto-saved via test scripts
